question: 在点数和目标形态变化时，哪些近似会损害分类稳定性？能否针对这些误差，用更合适的统计表示、精度分配和共享计算结构，获得优于现有实现的质量—成本取舍？
purpose: Bounded feature necessity ablation, not a new algorithm claim or global subset optimum

data.split: Retain audited train/validation sequence split, no new test use; validation is reused development data
data.representation: proxy only; existing train-derived output scales frozen
data.history: Same sequence/sensor/GT track; current plus preceding six retained observations; sparse observations do not update history; no coordinate alignment or time expiry

training.reference: software_convergence proxy_natural; analysis control only, not promoted over A/B
training.loss: Same common class-weighted CE as software_convergence
training.sampling: Exactly same per-seed/epoch natural-coverage schedule: 50% clean, 12.5% quarter,12.5% central,25% matched natural sparse; integer remainder alternates
training.normalization_calibration: Reuse common train-only expected-mixture normalization and 16384 calibration row identities, project columns; frozen output scales; frozen QAT scales after warmup
training.initialization: Draw one full21 model per seed; copy shared layers/columns; when removing duplicate10 while keeping6, add W10 to W6 before warmup. Other removed normalized inputs are zero in initialization comparison. Floating summation tolerance disclosed
training.full21_reproduction: Require exported integer weights, bias, multipliers and clean logits to match previous proxy_natural model for the same seed; mismatch blocks dependent interpretation

evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired full-sequence draws; per-seed and three-seed mean; exploratory, not formal noninferiority or independent significance proof
evaluation.group_reject: On any supported condition/group: all three accuracy deltas negative and mean below -0.01
evaluation.composite: Equal average of clean, average of three quarter repeats, central_half,sparse_single,sparse_context
evaluation.choice: Among reduced subsets passing every development tolerance choose smallest dimension, then higher composite mean, then lexical name. Otherwise retain full21 for this coverage. This does not automatically replace deployed/main A/B
evaluation.A_B_guard: Also apply unchanged software_convergence promotion rule against old A/B; any failed gate keeps A main/B alternative

duplicate_diagnostic.operation: W6 <- W6+W10 as signed int16 storage with signed9-bit logical range; delete input10, keep biases/scales/multipliers unchanged
duplicate_diagnostic.verification: Independent Python and C trace on train-only boundary/random inputs before training; all 13 development views after training; no claim of all-INT8 equivalence
duplicate_diagnostic.comparison: Report merged coefficients outside [-127,127]; no extra clipped-weight candidate or tuning

preflight: Verify frozen data/source SHA and sequence identity
Projection/mapping and duplicate equality on all used train pools
Pair initialization and calibration row identity
Single-pass subset frontend vs frozen native on boundary cases
stop: Run only these 12 trajectories, final epochs/all seeds retained; on real implementation/data mismatch halt dependent work and investigate with evidence; on budget stop retain partial results, no extra training. Always complete analysis and records for completed results.
review: Single executor review, no independent reviewer claim. No full backward search, no new network hidden widths, losses, feature additions, history changes or RTL. Old frozen experiments remain unchanged.
